# Core import-direction baseline -- TRANSITIONAL, not a permanent allowlist.
# internal/core is the leaf tier and must not import internal/component or
# internal/plugins (ai/rules/module-tiers.md). Each row is one grandfathered
# (importer-file, imported-package) pair with its fix route; the gate FAILS on
# a NEW pair and on a STALE row (import gone but row kept), so this file can
# only shrink. An empty file means full direction enforcement, zero exceptions.
# See plan/spec-layout-0-umbrella.md (child 2) and plan/learned (layout-2).
# columns: <core-file>\t<imported-package>\t<fix-route>: <rationale>

internal/core/diagnostic/types.go	internal/component/plugin	needs-design: diagnostic types reference plugin config types (spec-tiers-0-umbrella tiers-5)
internal/core/resolve/resolve.go	internal/component/config/storage	hand-fixable: Storage() manufactures component-owned backends; move the constructor component-side or invert via a core interface
internal/core/resolve/resolve_test.go	internal/component/config/storage	hand-fixable: fakeStore implements storage.Storage for the resolve test; define a minimal local interface or relocate the test with the constructor when resolve.go is inverted
